items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Cecil Scott was a drummer and we worked in St. Louis. Tremendous organizer. Had a tremendous band we thought, you know.

ctx.x: Because you're coming up to '28 by now.

Yeah but it's not the same Cecil Scott. They got the names mixed. Cecil Scott was a drummer and we worked in St. Louis. Tremendous organizer. Had a tremendous band we thought, you know. Worked at a place called The Congo Roof Garden.
How do you say it again?
